svg.text: Your library holds seven JEPA items, all preprints or reports from the Meta/LeCun line of work.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: “We introduce the Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA), a non-generative approach

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for self-supervised learning from images. The idea behind I-JEPA is simple: from a single context block,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: predict the representations of various target blocks in the same image.”

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Assran et al., 2023, p. 1. The page number is exact, taken from the PDF itself.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Assran, M., Duval, Q., Misra, I., Bojanowski, P., Vincent, P., Rabbat, M., LeCun, Y., & Ballas, N. (2023).

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Self-Supervised Learning from Images with a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture. http://arxiv.org/abs/2301.08243v3

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: LeCun, Y. (2022). A Path Towards Autonomous Machine Intelligence [Position paper]. OpenReview.
